notes: Direct HTTP fetch (tier 1) + Playwright/Chromium render (tier 2) for header-only totals; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Christmas: found via real nav breadcrumb Moebel>Dekoration>Festtagsdekoration>Weihnachtsdekoration (curated hub at /dekoration/weihnachtsdekoration/); its 12 curated children (own dedicated slugs, some crossing into Lighting/Textiles/Office-Supplies sortiments per Rule 7 coexistence) are SSR-rendered with exact nav_link-count data-count attributes, cross-checked against 2 rendered PLPs (Christmas Lighting matched 1126 exactly; Christmas Gift Wrapping curated count 494 preferred over a rounded 500 seen on the raw filtered URL). Other holidays found via the site's own 'Anlass' (occasion) facet, each a dedicated PLP with its own title/meta/breadcrumb (Moebel>Halloween Dekoration etc, not routed through Festtagsdekoration): Halloween, Ostern(Easter), Valentinstag, Nikolaus, Silvester(New Year's Eve), Muttertag, Vatertag, Oktoberfest, Schulanfang(Back to School). Counts taken from rendered '<N> Produkte' PLP header (Playwright, networkidle+settle); cross-checked against facet-breakdown sums where available (good agreement for Halloween/Ostern/Valentinstag/Silvester/Muttertag/Vatertag/Nikolaus; Nikolaus and Schulanfang display exactly '500' which is suspiciously round and, for Schulanfang, facet-sum(~121) is far below 500 -> flagged both for manual review rather than dropped, since sample products on both pages were genuinely on-theme, not generic filler). Excluded as NOT seasonal/holiday: 'Festtagsdekoration' itself (its own filter mixes Ostern+Weihnachten+Partydekoration into one non-single-holiday bucket, Rule 5/6); the site's other 'Anlass' values are personal life-events, not calendar holidays, and were excluded: Geburtstag, Hochzeit, Hochzeitstag, Konfirmation, Taufe, Jubilaeum, Geburt, Kommunion, Junggesellenabschied, Reise, Schwangerschaft, Ferien, Spieleabend, Aufheben; 'Party' and 'Festival' Anlass values are real dedicated pages but generic (music-festival/party theme, not tied to a specific named occasion) so excluded per Rule 5/6. Checked and confirmed ABSENT (all fall back to generic 'Gefunden auf Otto.de' search results, no dedicated category page): St. Patrick's Day, Diwali, Holi, Eid, Thanksgiving, Black Friday, Herbst/Winter/Fruehling/Sommer (Autumn/Winter/Spring/Summer). No Indian-festival or Diwali taxonomy on this German site, as expected.
